locals {
  iam_user_name   = "TJ"
  iam_policy_name = "GlacierEFSEC2"
}

resource "aws_iam_user" "tj" {
  name = local.iam_user_name
  path = "/"

  tags = {
    Name    = local.iam_user_name
    Purpose = "EC2/EFS/Glacier management user"
  }

  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_policy" "glacier_efs_ec2" {
  name        = local.iam_policy_name
  description = "Broad EC2 management permissions plus EFS client-mount access and Glacier vault and multipart-upload permissions."

  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      {
        Sid    = "EC2Management"
        Effect = "Allow"
        Action = [
          "ec2:RunInstances",
          "ec2:TerminateInstances",
          "ec2:StartInstances",
          "ec2:StopInstances",
          "ec2:RebootInstances",
          "ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute",
          "ec2:CreateTags",
          "ec2:DeleteTags",
          "ec2:CreateSecurityGroup",
          "ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup",
          "ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress",
          "ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress",
          "ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress",
          "ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress",
          "ec2:CreateKeyPair",
          "ec2:DeleteKeyPair",
          "ec2:ImportKeyPair",
          "ec2:CreateVolume",
          "ec2:DeleteVolume",
          "ec2:ModifyVolume",
          "ec2:AttachVolume",
          "ec2:DetachVolume",
          "ec2:CreateSnapshot",
          "ec2:DeleteSnapshot",
          "ec2:CreateImage",
          "ec2:DeregisterImage",
          "ec2:AllocateAddress",
          "ec2:ReleaseAddress",
          "ec2:AssociateAddress",
          "ec2:DisassociateAddress",
          "ec2:CreateNetworkInterface",
          "ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface",
          "ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute",
          "ec2:CreateVpc",
          "ec2:DeleteVpc",
          "ec2:CreateSubnet",
          "ec2:DeleteSubnet",
          "ec2:CreateRouteTable",
          "ec2:DeleteRouteTable",
          "ec2:CreateRoute",
          "ec2:DeleteRoute",
          "ec2:AssociateRouteTable",
          "ec2:DisassociateRouteTable",
          "ec2:CreateInternetGateway",
          "ec2:DeleteInternetGateway",
          "ec2:AttachInternetGateway",
          "ec2:DetachInternetGateway",
          "ec2:CreateNatGateway",
          "ec2:DeleteNatGateway",
          "ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate",
          "ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate",
          "ec2:ModifyLaunchTemplate",
          "ec2:CreatePlacementGroup",
          "ec2:DeletePlacementGroup"
        ]
        Resource = "*"
      },
      {
        Sid    = "EC2ReadOnly"
        Effect = "Allow"
        Action = [
          "ec2:DescribeInstances",
          "ec2:DescribeInstanceStatus",
          "ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes",
          "ec2:DescribeImages",
          "ec2:DescribeVolumes",
          "ec2:DescribeSnapshots",
          "ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups",
          "ec2:DescribeVpcs",
          "ec2:DescribeVpcAttribute",
          "ec2:DescribeSubnets",
          "ec2:DescribeSubnetAttribute",
          "ec2:DescribeRouteTables",
          "ec2:DescribeInternetGateways",
          "ec2:DescribeNatGateways",
          "ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones",
          "ec2:DescribeRegions",
          "ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes",
          "ec2:DescribeTags",
          "ec2:DescribeKeyPairs",
          "ec2:DescribeAddresses",
          "ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces",
          "ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates",
          "ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions",
          "ec2:DescribePlacementGroups"
        ]
        Resource = "*"
      },
      {
        Sid    = "EFSClientMount"
        Effect = "Allow"
        Action = [
          "elasticfilesystem:ClientMount",
          "elasticfilesystem:ClientWrite",
          "elasticfilesystem:ClientRootAccess",
          "elasticfilesystem:DescribeFileSystems",
          "elasticfilesystem:DescribeMountTargets",
          "elasticfilesystem:DescribeMountTargetSecurityGroups",
          "elasticfilesystem:DescribeAccessPoints",
          "elasticfilesystem:DescribeFileSystemPolicy"
        ]
        Resource = "arn:aws:elasticfilesystem:*:*:file-system/*"

        Sid    = "GlacierVaultAndMultipartUpload"
        Effect = "Allow"
        Action = [
          "glacier:CreateVault",
          "glacier:DeleteVault",
          "glacier:DescribeVault",
          "glacier:GetVaultAccessPolicy",
          "glacier:SetVaultAccessPolicy",
          "glacier:GetVaultLock",
          "glacier:SetVaultLock",
          "glacier:InitiateMultipartUpload",
          "glacier:UploadMultipartPart",
          "glacier:CompleteMultipartUpload",
          "glacier:AbortMultipartUpload",
          "glacier:ListMultipartUploads",
          "glacier:ListParts",
          "glacier:UploadArchive",
          "glacier:DeleteArchive",
          "glacier:InitiateJob",
          "glacier:GetJobOutput",
          "glacier:DescribeJob",
          "glacier:ListJobs"
        ]
        Resource = "arn:aws:glacier:*:*:vaults/*"
      },
      {
        Sid      = "GlacierListVaults"
        Effect   = "Allow"
        Action   = ["glacier:ListVaults"]
        Resource = "*"
      }
    ]
  })

  tags = {
    Name = local.iam_policy_name
  }
}

###############################################################################
# AWS Managed Grafana with Prometheus + CloudWatch monitoring access
#
# Creates:
#   * An IAM role that the AWS Managed Grafana workspace "Grafana" assumes.
#   * A least-privilege customer-managed IAM policy granting query/read access
#     to Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus (AMP) and Amazon CloudWatch
#     metrics.
#   * The Amazon Managed Grafana workspace itself.
#
# The role's trust policy restricts assumption of the role to the supplied
# monitoring AWS accounts (falling back to the current account when none are
# provided).
###############################################################################

data "aws_caller_identity" "current" {}

variable "monitoring_account_ids" {
  description = "AWS account IDs allowed to assume the Grafana monitoring role. When empty, only the current account is allowed."
  type        = list(string)
  default     = []
}

locals {
  grafana_workspace_name = "Grafana"

  # Fall back to the current account when no explicit monitoring accounts are supplied.
  monitoring_account_ids = length(var.monitoring_account_ids) > 0 ? var.monitoring_account_ids : [data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id]

  common_tags = {
    Application = "AmazonManagedGrafana"
    ManagedBy   = "Terraform"
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Trust policy
#
# Only the Amazon Managed Grafana service, acting on behalf of a workspace in
# one of the specified monitoring accounts, is allowed to assume this role.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
data "aws_iam_policy_document" "grafana_assume_role" {
  statement {
    sid     = "AllowManagedGrafanaInMonitoringAccounts"
    effect  = "Allow"
    actions = ["sts:AssumeRole"]

    principals {
      type        = "Service"
      identifiers = ["grafana.amazonaws.com"]
    }

    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "aws:SourceAccount"
      values   = local.monitoring_account_ids
    }
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_role" "grafana" {
  name               = "grafana-monitoring-role"
  description        = "Role assumed by the AWS Managed Grafana workspace to query Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus and CloudWatch metrics."
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.grafana_assume_role.json

  tags = local.common_tags
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Permissions policy
#
# Least-privilege access to the AMP query APIs and the CloudWatch metric read
# APIs used by the Grafana data sources. Amazon Managed Grafana requires these
# actions on all resources ("*") because the underlying APIs do not support
# resource-level scoping.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
data "aws_iam_policy_document" "grafana_monitoring" {
  statement {
    sid    = "PrometheusQueryAccess"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = [
      "aps:ListWorkspaces",
      "aps:DescribeWorkspace",
      "aps:QueryMetrics",
      "aps:GetLabels",
      "aps:GetSeries",
      "aps:GetMetricMetadata",
    ]

    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "CloudWatchMetricsReadAccess"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = [
      "cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms",
      "cloudwatch:GetMetricData",
      "cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics",
      "cloudwatch:ListMetrics",
    ]

    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid       = "ResourceTagDiscovery"
    effect    = "Allow"
    actions   = ["tag:GetResources"]
    resources = ["*"]
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_policy" "grafana_monitoring" {
  name        = "grafana-monitoring-policy"
  description = "Grants the AWS Managed Grafana workspace read/query access to Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus and CloudWatch metrics."
  policy      = data.aws_iam_policy_document.grafana_monitoring.json

  tags = local.common_tags
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "grafana_monitoring" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.grafana.name
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.grafana_monitoring.arn
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Amazon Managed Grafana workspace
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "aws_grafana_workspace" "grafana" {
  name                     = local.grafana_workspace_name
  description              = "Amazon Managed Grafana workspace for Prometheus and CloudWatch monitoring."
  account_access_type      = "CURRENT_ACCOUNT"
  authentication_providers = ["SAML"]
  permission_type          = "CUSTOMER_MANAGED"
  role_arn                 = aws_iam_role.grafana.arn
  data_sources             = ["PROMETHEUS", "CLOUDWATCH"]

  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}
